evidence.passage: Table1 labels Camgoz2020 as simultaneous recognition/translation on PHOENIX; Singh2023 is sign-to-text translation, Rao2024 a systematic review and Patel2024 a comparative review. Other rows do not establish continuous linguistic-sign recognition.

The matching 2023 ACL title is authored by Li and colleagues, not Singh. The abstract describes classification of ASL alphabets and custom signs into text, rather than establishing continuous linguistic-sign recognition. Because the review gives different authors, the intended citation remains unresolved.
